setting_selection: Retain the registered default. Other registered settings are sensitivity diagnostics; no automatic winner selection.
benchmark_gate: For every target, default pooled primary loss must be no worse than both comparators, and no worse than the global comparator in at least two of three annual folds. This is a predictive screen, not proof of fair player rankings.
material_bias_interpretation: Screening tolerances: 10 runs or 1 wicket per 100 role opportunities; project choices, not universal calibration standards.
calibration_alert: Flag a supported group when absolute observed-minus-predicted bias exceeds the target tolerance and its whole-match 10th-90th percentile interval excludes zero. Sparse groups remain uncertain, never silently passed.
bootstrap_interpretation: Conditional on the fitted annual models; all targets and comparisons share match resamples. Does not include refitting or multiplicity correction for exploratory subgroup alerts.
reserved_evaluation_gate: Require valid prediction contracts, the default benchmark gate, and no material supported-group calibration alerts. A failed gate requires a documented development-only decision before reserved evaluation, not silent retuning.
